title: feat(web): share the app shell
body:
Closes #100 --- ## Agent summary Each page repeats its own header, and the look does not match the mockup. `PageFrame` gives every page one shell and one page header. The shell holds the logo, the links, the theme button and the count. ```diff -
logo, links, title
+ logo, links, count, theme, Settings + page body ``` Overview and the project page pass those typed props. ```tsx ``` ## Caveats
1 departure - The shell draws its own scrollbar lane when the page is taller than the window, because the replay browser hides the native bar.
3 loose ends - Filter and sort do not change the lists. Later tickets own that behaviour. - The project view buttons do not switch the project view. Later tickets own Board, Graph and Table. - The theme button saves the choice in `localStorage`. Issue #101 owns the saved theme.
6 assumptions - The private mockup URL returns only a frame, so the palette is the published Geist palette. - Light uses canvas `#ffffff`, ink `#171717` and accent `#0070f3`. - Dark uses canvas `#000000`, ink `#ededed` and accent `#3291ff`. - Theme values live in `src/tokens.stylex.ts` and pass `lightValues` and `darkValues`, because one imported palette object emits one theme class. - The project header lists Board, Graph and Table, and Board stays pressed, because those views are later tickets. - The theme walk uses headed `agent-browser`, because the shipped runner has no hover action and starts headless.
## Conceptual Changes The branch adds `AppShell()`, `PageFrame()`, `PageHeader()` and bundled Geist fonts, but the shell count conflicts with `Page()` freshness. ```mermaid flowchart TB frame["PageFrame()
shared page layout"]:::added shell["AppShell()
navigation and needs-you count"]:::added header["PageHeader()
title and typed controls"]:::added api["/api/needs-you
current needs-you tickets and PRs"]:::same page["Page() in needs-you.tsx
live needs-you list"]:::same fonts["fonts.css
bundled Geist faces"]:::added font["font
system families -> bundled Geist"]:::changed canvas["root.canvas
colours -> colours and typography"]:::changed frame -->|renders| shell frame -->|renders| header shell -->|reads| api page -->|reads| api shell -.->|"1. conflicts needs-you freshness"| page fonts -->|provides| font font -->|styles| canvas canvas -->|styles| frame linkStyle 0,1,2,5,6,7 stroke:#16a34a,stroke-width:2px classDef added fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#16a34a,color:#14532d classDef changed fill:#fef9c3,stroke:#ca8a04,color:#713f12 classDef removed fill:#fee2e2,stroke:#dc2626,color:#7f1d1d,stroke-dasharray:4 3 classDef same fill:#f3f4f6,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#374151 ``` #### Legend 🟩 added | 🟨 changed | 🟥 removed | ⬜ unchanged `duplicates` same responsibility again | `conflicts` incompatible outcomes | `redefines` changed meaning for existing users ### Important Questions
1. conflicts needs-you freshness: Should AppShell() follow the same overview events as Page() in src/needs-you.tsx? `Page()` in `src/needs-you.tsx` reloads `/api/needs-you` on `overview` events. `AppShell()` in `src/shell.tsx` reads the same route only when it mounts. When a poll adds a needs-you ticket, the list updates while the navigation count keeps its previous value.
REVIEW: NONCE: conceptual-reviewer-a466-a171@1792450768558317888 PENDING: ### Answers 1. Should AppShell() follow the same overview events as Page() in src/needs-you.tsx? Answer: Yes. Keep the initial load, reload `/api/needs-you` on `overview` events through the shared `onAppEvent` helper, and unsubscribe on unmount. This implements the existing scope of #100. ## Proof 1. ✅ Fresh replay shows the shared shell and Needs you 1 on every page, including the empty Inbox. Verifier: verified. shot `.devkit/proof/item-1/overview.png` `52acd79c65814afaadb0642066308907592b52e02f12ceb02402afc5558232cb`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-1/needs-you.png` `694b0241418a89723c31a1fd8fc4254962f9224e80fd3898b9c70dba15c30902`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-1/inbox.png` `03c9a7add22bcb22804261b079d9f16f0bb191faa7bc318b399e89c853ef87e0`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-1/settings.png` `2e6f7651bb9f6cf6a6cb78f54019ddc55de1923418cac86653512773f9a89aad`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-1/project.png` `6a903d66d8a4a904af060dac1ede5a638be93d03cc17fa695676db21d1f0dcfa`. ![overview](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd9d5e21-f4ca-4e75-8eb2-30f22154f1c3) ![needs you](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6bdf0da0-b706-4002-b82a-c29f3bd265ee) ![inbox](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fee33d47-93a5-4035-9e21-b3b0b3ef90b4) ![settings](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d1b2ddf2-d036-4d14-b70f-5cd88f9f6f9c) ![project](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a6b12631-288c-4b7c-8010-464bb57ef51e) ./.devkit/proof/item-1/session.webm
Before and after - **Asserts:** every page shows the shared header, and Needs you shows the open item count. - **Before:** each page repeats its own header. - **After:** Overview, Needs you, Inbox, Settings and the project page show the same shell. Needs you shows 1, including on the empty Inbox. - Edge: the empty Inbox still shows the shell and the count.
2. ✅ Captures show real pointer hover in both themes. Inbox backgrounds are `rgb(242, 242, 242)` in light and `rgb(26, 26, 26)` in dark. The script confirmed `:hover` without `data-hover`. Theme captures confirm the palette, focus ring and scrollbars. Verifier: verified. shot `.devkit/proof/item-2/hover-rest.png` `03f41d69c3f231e0a441b6f958ede5ba2c36f2711239226cedcf3cc6b0dd18c7`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-2/hover-light.png` `ba9333571009af29f8fab03a319db6019cddb98b315cfa18e2969df0cf79fa45`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-2/hover-dark.png` `60d44b36d6699a6bf2672161da44af5b00cde96eb3258fa418ffbd1702808abb`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-2/overview-light.png` `a74e0dfafedecccd688cb67b7be7d61b76bbf9e5258bde8d9f5200e3d13e3b34`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-2/overview-dark.png` `639d6583320afde405e5dc63b7806b420d77d309a44fa9e0d0658bbf0c672157`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-2/overview-focus.png` `0c8a26bb8fec1d42b3d7a1fd63fa122c765e33d819c2c69b44beed6116252a9d`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-2/scroll-light.png` `e47d4691cb6de7069f4627006c96e412d04e3b9a34e7a0e4e335be6c39baffa5`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-2/scroll-dark.png` `09875912053bcf953b16ff0027cce883ab265bd6efda4aa6653659f066ef6912`. ![hover rest](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/41556407-af7d-4640-91e8-93ea467d5833) ![hover light](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2f5e9112-3ebb-400b-afb7-1a2ae652fc1b) ![hover dark](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5dcff4d5-a6b9-45b1-8245-fda4a122098e) ![overview light](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b6221f19-6762-47df-b00d-f926136ecd17) ![overview dark](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0702755-c7f7-4c6b-8dd9-d82071c10a7b) ![overview focus](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9dc7fec1-b033-4478-9b3e-b1c101782ccb) ![scroll light](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/11db7ce1-cb8e-44a0-878d-b766985da514) ![scroll dark](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b597a093-8f55-4f01-a658-bbacf5e2f1b2) ./.devkit/proof/item-2/session.webm
Before and after - **Asserts:** light and dark match the mockup palette, hover states, focus rings and scrollbars. - **Before:** the pages do not match the mockup palette. - **After:** pointer hover paints the Inbox link in both themes. Focus and themed scrollbars show in both themes. - The walk uses headed `agent-browser`, because the shipped runner has no hover action.
3. ✅ `PageHeaderProps` types title, filter, sort, search and views. Overview and project pass these props through `PageFrame`. Verifier: verified. shot `.devkit/proof/item-3/overview-header.png` `8f462636c4841998b8e6961c61d4980a0ea93928b63305f298fd47f3389fb3a6`. shot `.devkit/proof/item-3/project-header.png` `6a903d66d8a4a904af060dac1ede5a638be93d03cc17fa695676db21d1f0dcfa`. ![overview header](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dff3f157-e301-478b-8e95-0501ab92c252) ![project header](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f7d2831-cb92-461b-a604-e31d6d1d04c9) ./.devkit/proof/item-3/session.webm
Before and after - **Asserts:** the page header takes typed props, and overview and project use it. - **Before:** each page builds its own header. - **After:** Overview shows filter, sort, search and Cards, Graph, Table. The project page shows filter, sort, search and Board, Graph, Table. - Filter and sort do not change the lists. The project view buttons do not switch the view.
4. ✅ The network log records only local HTTP requests and an embedded font data URL. Geist Sans loads. Verifier: verified. shot `.devkit/proof/item-4/fonts-local.png` `52acd79c65814afaadb0642066308907592b52e02f12ceb02402afc5558232cb`. `proof/font-hosts.log` says `hosts none`. ![fonts local](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/470539f0-b6ec-4c3f-bffd-e7a8ce378319) ./.devkit/proof/item-4/session.webm
Before and after - **Asserts:** the page loads no font from a third-party host. - **Before:** the page has no bundled Geist face. - **After:** the network log records local requests and one embedded font data URL. `src/fonts.css` names the bundled faces. - Edge: a blank host list in that log still reports `hosts none`.
## Merge Danger **Door:** ↔️ two-way **Blast Radius:** 👥 users - A bad colour or font change changes every page, because `PageFrame` wraps each page.
How `AppShell` and `PageHeader` sit in `PageFrame`. Overview, Needs you, Inbox, Settings and the project page render through that frame.
